project_description: TaskFlow is a task management application designed to help users organize, track, and prioritize daily activities. The web/mobile-based app allows users to create tasks, set deadlines, categorize items, and receive notifications. It aims to improve personal productivity through a minimalist interface.
functional_requirements: FR1: Users must be able to sign up, log in, and reset passwords via email.
FR2: Users can create tasks with a title, description, and optional due date.
FR3: Users can assign labels or "tags" (e.g., Work, Personal, Urgent) to tasks.
FR4: Users can mark tasks as 'Pending', 'In Progress', or 'Completed'.
FR5: Users can set priority (Low, Medium, High) for each task.
FR6: Users can delete individual tasks or clear all completed tasks.
FR7: Users can search for tasks by keyword or filter by date/priority/status.
FR8: The system shall send push/email notifications 30 minutes before a task is due.
non_functional_requirements: NFR1: The application should load the task list in under 2 seconds.
NFR2: Real-time updates should sync across devices within 500ms.
NFR3: The interface must follow minimalist design principles.
NFR4: The app must be fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop views.
NFR5: Task data must be persisted in a database (PostgreSQL/MongoDB) to prevent data loss on refresh.
NFR6: The system should maintain 99.9% uptime.
NFR7: User passwords must be hashed using bcrypt before storage.
NFR8: All API endpoints must be protected using JWT (JSON Web Tokens).

tech_stack_hints.backend: Node.js with Express / Python with FastAPI
